text: A minor UI typo — cosmetic, no functional impact, explicitly flagged as non-urgent by the customer. High confidence classification. I will draft a brief acknowledgment.

args.complaint: Typo on the Reports dashboard — column header reads 'Montly Summary' instead of 'Monthly Summary'. Customer says it is not urgent.

result.response: Hi Nina, thank you for taking the time to flag this — we really appreciate the attention to detail! We have logged the typo in our Reports section and it will be corrected in the next interface update. We're glad you're enjoying the product overall, and feedback like yours helps us keep improving. The Support Team.
result.internal_notes: Cosmetic typo logged. Forward to frontend team as a minor bug fix. No SLA urgency — next sprint is fine.

decision.reasoning: The customer is reporting a minor UI typo — 'Montly' instead of 'Monthly' — in the Reports section header. This is a cosmetic product defect with no functional impact, no financial harm, and no urgency. The customer's tone is friendly and they explicitly state it is not urgent. Confidence is high. A brief, friendly acknowledgment thanking the customer for the report and confirming it has been filed is the appropriate next step.
decision.why: Minor cosmetic typo with no functional impact — P2 with a friendly acknowledgment draft.
